next_decisions: Approve or reject a native function-expression contract for count/split/substring/arithmetic.
Approve exact OCIL questionnaire-to-manual response mapping beyond the bounded procedure projection.
Approve native capability contracts for remaining WMI/access-token features or retain explicit exclusions.
Reclassify legacy wmi_* and accesstoken_* under one Deprecated OVAL Tests statistic; keep wmi57_* in supported WMI coverage.
Define the typed native Input/Parameter relation adapter for XCCDF Value operators (starting with less_than_or_equal), including allowed values, defaults, cardinality, and check-export binding.
Define the native collection-expression lowering for multi-operand unique/merge without changing OVAL ordering, duplicate, empty, or error semantics.
Finalize deterministic source-identity disambiguation for readable native IDs, preserving source IDs and the 64-character native identifier limit.
Complete converter lowering for xsi:nil selectors using existing windows.cmdlet nullable contracts; add null, empty, and non-null regression vectors.
Wire ordered float comparisons through the existing native float contract with explicit precision, NaN, infinity, and lexical-error semantics.
Treat case-insensitive equality as an equality path only where the capability contract proves identical traversal scope; retain pattern-path rejection.
